messages:
kim.prod: Kickoff: we need a terse rollout plan for the regioned model-pin + feature-decay behavior. Goal: let customers pin versions, but also provide an automated decay policy so old pins don't block global optimizations. Looking for sharp guardrails and quick rollback.

pat.csm: Customers asking: how long can a pin stay active? Legal wants an SLA clause for 'legacy pin retention' and a way to request emergency unpinning.

raj.k: Proposed policy: pins expire after 90 days by default unless customer sets `pin.retention=forever`. For `forever` pins we surface a hidden cost alert and require a support ticket with justification. We also allow per-tenant manual unpin in console.

olivia.p: Safety-first: rollout should be tenant opt-in with staged slices: SMOKE (0.1% traffic, 1 tenant), SMALL (1%), MED (10%), FULL. Each stage requires synthetic + live checks. Max 48h per stage; can abort earlier if gates fail.

kim.prod: What gates?

raj.k: Metrics gates: per-tenant p99 <= baseline + 120ms, delta cost per 10k tokens <= 10%, error-rate delta <= 0.25pp. Also require no synthetic correctness drift > 1% (top-3 match).

pat.csm: Enterprise ask: when we auto-decay a pin, notify customer 14 days prior and provide a CLI command to renew. Also add a read-only audit log for pin changes.

olivia.p: Infra notes: pre-warm KV cache 25m before each bump. Autoscale cushion for first 12m. Also schedule a background compile job for the model variant to reduce cold starts.

sre-bot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pin-decay-rollout-2026 :white_check_mark:

raj.k: Experiments during rollout: 1) decay-enabled vs decay-disabled (randomize tenants) to measure fragmentation and ops overhead. 2) thin-fallback vs queue-backpressure for overload strategy. Minimum sample: 40k requests/arm or 36h.

kim.prod: For thin-fallback vs queue: prefer thin-fallback as automatic default but allow tenants to opt into queue-backpressure if they prefer eventual higher quality. We must surface X-Redwood-Mode: fallback|queued in responses.

olivia.p: Rollback automation proposal: automated rollback triggers if p99 > baseline +180ms for 10m OR error rate >0.6% for 5m OR probe fail rate >3% for 15m. On rollback, revert to pinned version and tag timeline in audit log. Also notify CS and page SRE if rollback is automated.

pat.csm: Add a tenant-level safety override: customer can set `pin.force=true` to prevent automated rollback for their traffic, but require manual acceptance: checkbox + documented risk.

raj.k: Observability: per-tenant dashboard card with current pin, days-to-expiry, active experiments, last-fallback, cumulative cost delta, and a one-click unpin button for CS.

kim.prod: Edge case: what if a pin blocks urgent security patch rollouts? Proposal: security-critical patches can force-unpin after a legal/ops review; we notify customers immediately and provide rollback window of 24h to re-pin. Document this in the playbook.

olivia.p: Pre-deploy checklist: 1) feature flag test in staging 2) pre-warm + compile job 3) synthetic baseline verification 4) one dry-run with internal tenant 5) enable small slice. Owners: Raj 1+5, Olivia 2+3, Pat 4.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-1 -> 2026-06-10T01:00:00Z, canary-2 -> 2026-06-10T03:30:00Z

kim.prod: Communication plan: 14-day pin-expiry notices, opt-in emails for early customers, rollback FAQ, and an admin UI tooltip explaining `pin.retention` consequences. Pat to draft templates.

pat.csm: I'll draft the comms and legal notification flow. Also collecting a list of customers who requested permanent pinning.

raj.k: One more: add a decay 'grace window' variable per-tenant (default 14d) that CS can override when approving requests. We'll surface in API as `pin.grace_days`.

kim.prod: Great. I'll assemble the rollout playbook and circulation doc by EOD tomorrow and schedule a signoff slot. Thanks all.
